What matters is that you are comfortable working with numbers, understand accounting logic, enjoy structured financial work and are motivated to develop further within a Group Finance environment. The position offers the opportunity to gain broad exposure to financial reporting, consolidation, IFRS and controlling topics within a complex, listed organisation and to gradually take on greater responsibility. Location: Berlin Your Task Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual Group reporting Assist in the preparation and review of reporting packages submitted by Group entities Support Group consolidation processes and related reconciliation activities Perform and review intercompany reconciliations Prepare supporting schedules, reconciliations and working papers for financial reporting purposes Support the analysis of financial statements, balance sheet and P&L movements Perform data quality and consistency checks across reporting systems and Group entities Support the preparation of financial information for the Group's external reporting Assist with IFRS accounting topics and the implementation of Group accounting guidelines Support year-end and interim audit processes and coordinate information requests from auditors Maintain and improve reporting templates, documentation and internal controls Work closely with local finance teams and other Group Finance functions Support ad-hoc reporting, accounting and finance projects Contribute to the continuous improvement and standardisation of Group reporting and controlling processes Your Profile Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics or a comparable field, or a relevant professional qualification Initial professional experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: - Group Accounting - Financial Reporting - Audit / Big 4 - Accounting - Consolidation - Financial Controlling Candidates with approximately 1-4 years of relevant experience are particularly welcome, although we are also open to strong candidates with less or somewhat more experience Good understanding of financial statements and accounting principles IFRS knowledge is an advantage, but not necessarily a prerequisite Experience with consolidation or Group reporting is an advantage Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data Experience with SAP or other ERP/reporting systems is an advantage Strong analytical skills and a structured, accurate and reliable way of working Hands-on attitude and willingness to work with detailed financial information Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate with colleagues across different functions and entities Very good English skills; German language skills are an advantage Your Perspective Interesting, varied and broad range of tasks in one of the largest real estate companies in Germany and Europe Good working atmosphere, communication culture "on a first-name basis" and a pleasant working atmosphere in an environment with flat hierarchies Individual training and coaching for professional and personal development in our Academy and with our in-house business coach Professionally equipped, in-house gym with trainers and courses at the headquarters in Berlin  Comprehensive company health management and company pension scheme Support on the way to work through a subsidy for the use of public transport and the option of leasing a bicycle through Eurorad Flexible working hours for an even better work-life balance Exciting virtual range of family-friendly benefits, including vacation programs, leisure and sports activities and consulting services with our partner company Voiio Opportunity to attend Bundesliga matches of FC Union Berlin, our favorite club Discounts in selected hotels worldwide with up to 30% on overnight stays and special conditions on food and drinks Employee discounts for special conditions in the areas of media, fashion, leisure, facilities and much more via a partner company Additional days off on Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve Have we sparked your interest?  Then click on "Apply now" and Alina Wegner will be happy to receive your application documents, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations. Aroundtown, Personalabteilung, Wittestraße 30, Haus F, 13509 Berlin

jobs.occupation: Director, R&D (f/m/d) Autoimmunity (Leiter/in - Forschung und Entwicklung)
jobs.description: Work ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsAdherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, OfficeJob DescriptionThermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our team  of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.Phadia is the leading supplier of fully automatic blood analysis systems for allergy and auto-immune diseases. With our innovative products, we set standards worldwide and assist clinicians in providing fast and reliable diagnoses, thus helping patients at an early stage. Phadia GmbH in Freiburg is the German subsidiary of the Immunodiagnostics division of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a global company that develops, manufactures and distributes in vitro diagnostics in the field of allergy and autoimmune diagnostics. Our customers expect a consistently reliable and high standard of quality from our products, which we ensure through innovative biochemical and medical technology solutions as well as highly qualified and motivated employees.Thermo Fisher Scientific’s R&D Autoimmunity department provides end-to-end scientific leadership for our Autoimmunity in vitro diagnostic (IVD) assay portfolio, spanning development, lifecycle management and continuous improvement. Operating within a regulated global environment (IVDR, FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485), the team delivers clinically robust, analytically sound, and commercially sustainable diagnostic solutions.For our team in Freiburg, we are looking for aDirector, R&D (f/m/d) AutoimmunityDiscover Impactful WorkAs Director of R&D, you’ll lead the team developing advanced autoimmune diagnostics that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. You’ll establish strategic direction for Autoimmunity R&D initiatives, own the R&D roadmap, and cultivate a culture of scientific excellence and collaboration. You'll establish strategic direction for R&D initiatives while cultivating a culture of scientific excellence and collaboration. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll oversee the full development lifecycle of IVD immunoassay from concept through commercialization, ensuring successful delivery of effective solutions.You'll support and develop teams of scientists, laboratory technicians and technical experts while maintaining strong connections across the organization to advance innovation and technological progress. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to scientific discovery through leadership of research programs and development of transformative products.This role is fully office-based at our Freiburg, Germany site. Some international travel will be required – up to 25% of working time, including overnight stays.A day in the LifeStrategic & Portfolio Leadership- Define and execute the Autoimmunity R&D strategy and roadmap aligned with portfolio and innovation priorities- Prioritize programs and allocate resources across innovation, lifecycle management, and regulatory commitments- Contribute to lifecycle planning (line extensions, upgrades, cost optimization, portfolio rationalization)Assay Development Execution- Lead end-to-end assay development: feasibility, design, risk analysis, verification and validation- Drive research on biomarkers and disease-relevant targets for potential diagnostic applications, and drive translation of selected opportunities into the closed, fully automated IVD platformRegulatory & Quality Compliance- Ensure compliance with IVDR, FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, and applicable regulations- Oversee DHF, technical documentation, risk management activities and regulatory submissions (with RA)- Ensure audit readiness and effective CAPA executionSustaining Engineering & Lifecycle Management- Provide technical oversight of post-market surveillance, and performance monitoring- Lead investigations into complaints, trends, and field issues; ensure timely root cause analysis and corrective actions- Address assay variability, stability, raw material changes, and manufacturing deviations- Support supplier changes, material obsolescence management, and supply continuityPeople & Organizational Leadership- Build and develop high performing R&D teams- Foster a culture of scientific rigor, accountability, and continuous improvement- Develop succession pipelines and technical career paths- Operate effectively within a global, matrixed organizationCross-Functional & External Collaboration- Partner with Product Innovation, Marketing, Quality & Regulatory and Medical Affairs to translate clinical, customer, and portfolio needs into product requirements- Collaborate with Clinical Affairs on validation strategies and studies- Develop and maintain scientific collaborations with KOLs, clinical networks, academic institutions, and external partners- Provide R&D governance of external research collaborations, including coordination of appropriate NDAs, CDAs, and MTAs with relevant functions- Represent R&D in governance forums and executive reviewsKeys to Success- Advanced Degree in Immunology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or related field- 10+ years of professional experience in IVD assay development- Extensive experience leading and coaching people leaders and individual contributors, building high performing R&D teams and developing organizational capabilities for the future- Demonstrated ability to establish clear priorities across a complex R&D portfolio, drive prioritization and trade-off decisions with teams and stakeholders, and allocate resources in line with strategic and business priorities- Demonstrated success delivering innovative products from concept through commercialization with stage-gate product development processes, managing complex projects, budgets and resources in a dynamic environment with competing priorities requiring strong prioritization- Strong scientific expertise relevant to autoimmune disease areas- Strong understanding of quality systems and regulatory requirements (FDA, ISO, GMP)- Demonstrated success leading organizational change, including evolving ways of working, strengthening accountability and collaboration, and shaping the culture and mindset required to improve organizational effectiveness- Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to create clarity, alignment and engagement through change- Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions, navigating a complex matrix organization- Strategic mindset paired with business acumen and customer orientation- Proficiency in English required; German highly preferredWhat we offer- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organisation- Outstanding career and development prospects- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement and innovationIf you are interested, please apply online with your CV and Motivation Letter.At
